dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: This study... it brings back some memories.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: As a child, I tried all sorts of ways to avoid books that taught aristocratic etiquette, but to no avail — I had no choice but to memorize them all.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Forget it, it's all in the past now. I shouldn't get myself down, I must look ahead to my new life.
